title: A2CN Rejection
description: The Section 7.5 act that refuses a specific offer and returns the turn to the rejecting party. Signing is OPTIONAL — an unsigned Rejection is conformant and is attributed as an unsigned observation — but verifying is not: once rejection_signature is present it MUST be checked against the Section 7.3.1 signed act object, whose payload for a rejection is rejected_offer_id and reason_code. reason_description is deliberately outside the signed scope: it is OPTIONAL, so signing it would make the signed field set depend on whether the sender filled it in, and it is untrusted free text (Section 13.7). The message object stays open so vendor fields pass through.

in_reply_to.description: The message_id of the offer or counteroffer being rejected (Section 7.5).

rejected_offer_id.description: The message_id of the rejected offer. Inside the signed scope, so a signed Rejection is tied to one specific act (Section 7.5).

sender_verification_method.description: DID URL of the verification method used to sign this message. REQUIRED when rejection_signature is present (Section 7.5).

protocol_version.description: Not carried on the wire by this implementation. A verifier rebuilding the signed act uses its own wire version unless the act states one (Section 7.3.1).

reason_code.description: Inside the signed scope: it is the substance of the refusal and the field a later dispute turns on (Section 7.5).

reason_description.description: Free text, OPTIONAL, and NOT covered by rejection_signature. Untrusted input (Section 13.7).

rejection_signature.description: OPTIONAL. Attached JWS Compact Serialization over base64url(ASCII(hash)) of the Section 7.3.1 signed act object. Not a JWT claim set.
